supporting_observations.claim: The account was created at 13:46:31 UTC, later than the alert's approximate 13:42 time, but within the requested review window.
The account-creation event identifies emma.stone as the actor. The matching logon ID was authenticated to the domain controller from WS-ESTONE-01's IP shortly before creation.
The new account is named tmp.rwong and was added to Temp-Staff by emma.stone, matching the supplied help-desk temporary-account practice.

known_telemetry_limitations: The records establish the account creation and Temp-Staff group addition, but do not provide a help-desk request or other business justification.
These records do not provide a complete account group-membership or privilege inventory, nor an account expiration setting.
claims_not_established: Whether tmp.rwong was requested for a legitimate business purpose or by the intended recipient.
Whether the account has any additional group memberships or privileges not represented in these records.
Whether the account was given an expiration date or was later disabled.
unrelated_findings: WS-ESTONE-01 accessed Postman identity/login endpoints; Postman is not listed among approved services. Review separately, and do not use this activity to decide the account-creation alert. (T098-00014, T098-00015, T098-00017, T098-00020)
WS-ESTONE-01 accessed a Google Docs document, while Google Docs is not listed among approved file-sharing or cloud-storage services. Review separately. (T098-00032, T098-00033)
Cisco AnyConnect's UI launched on WS-ESTONE-01 despite the inventory stating there is no VPN; these records do not show a VPN connection. Review separately. (T098-00009, T098-00010)

Explorer recorded UserAssist entries for PowerShell on WS-ESTONE-01. These entries are not evidence of the account-creation mechanism and should be reviewed separately if warranted. (T098-00008, T098-00026)
